description: Sanitize user input before logging by removing or encoding special characters that could be interpreted as control sequences. Use a logging framework that supports structured logging with proper escaping or apply custom sanitization logic to prevent injection of malicious content.

example.after:
const sanitizedInput = userInput.replace(/[\r\n\t]/g, ' ');
logger.info(`User action performed: ${sanitizedInput}`);

fix_pattern.instructions: Sanitize user input before logging by removing or encoding special characters that could be interpreted as control sequences. Use a logging framework that supports structured logging with proper escaping or apply custom sanitization logic to prevent injection of malicious content.
